lines.text: Why would you buy a gaming PC when you could just email every single gaming company and ask them for a free PC?
lines.title: POV: you asked every PC brand for a FREE gaming PC 🖥️😭

lines.text: I wanted to see if this would actually work, so I found every single PC brand and asked them for a free gaming PC.
lines.title: POV: you asked every PC brand for a FREE gaming PC 🖥️😭

lines.text: In total, I sent 567 emails, and I'm just so surprised that there were that many companies selling them.
113 of them gave me an auto reply, which I found pretty lame because AI was clearly doing all of the work.
48 of them failed to send, so I'm pretty sure I was just sent to the spam.
And 328 of them straight out ghosted me, and at this point I was really starting to lose hope.
But I did end up getting 78 responses.
So now I'm going to go to Hedwig Mail and draft a convincing response.
And right when I click run, Hedwig is going to launch an agent that's going to draft a response to every single email and send them all out.
Unfortunately 51 of them did say no, but 5 of them did end up sending me free stickers, which I guess is kind of neat.
But I was pretty surprised to see that 22 of them actually said yes.
Honestly, I was pretty shocked with these results and I have no clue what they're going to send me, but I do not need that many gaming PCs.
